benchmark_name: Post-activation C2A reserve attestation and tense-gap challenge v13

measured_result.unknown_safety: 8/8 for combined runtime and master exact
measured_result.historical_interpretation: The pre-answer generic present prediction abhiyaa was independently validated; afceliyeen remained outside the present-only class activation, establishing the generic C2A past gap.

answer_sources.source_family: Guuleed 2012 Aan Ooyee Albaabka ii Xidha / Maktabadda transcription
answer_sources.attested_context: Qofkii i abhiyaa, wuu ammaan heliye
answer_sources.feature_resolution: Qofkii supplies a singular human subject, resolving the attested abhiyaa token to 3sg masculine. Present is scored from the finite -yaa form and general-present sense. Mood is intentionally outside the scored feature scope.

answer_sources.source_family: Cali Cabdi Coomay / Afka Shacabka natural narrative
answer_sources.attested_context: iyana may fahmin oo waxa ay ugu afceliyeen mooyi
answer_sources.feature_resolution: Iyana supplies a plural subject and the surrounding narrative is past, resolving afceliyeen as 3pl past. Mood is intentionally outside the scored feature scope.

afceliyeen.reason: Stage 1O generic C2A class activation is present-indicative only and has no class-level past generator.

experimental_design.purpose: Verify a pre-existing reserve present prediction against later independent attestation while simultaneously exposing whether an independently attested C2A past 3pl form remains outside the present-only generic activation.

independence_limits.reason: v13 is a small post-activation verification benchmark. It checks whether a prediction made before answer lookup is attested and whether a new tense remains unsupported; it is not a blind rule-discovery benchmark.

notes: Stage 1O activated abhi and afceli as part of the complete four-lemma Stage 1N cohort before either v13 answer was searched. The untouched v13 measurement validated the pre-existing abhiyaa present prediction at full scored features and left afceliyeen unrecognized, establishing the class-level past gap. The historical 1/2 baseline is locked. Future generic C2A past improvement is allowed only from development evidence independent of v13 answer rows; v13 may never authorize an afceli special case.
